name: io.github.kammcs/buildit-mcp
title: buildIt.Social
description: Work with buildIt.Social projects, items, comments, pages and channels with your own token.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A buildIt.Social personal access token (it starts with buildit_pat_). Give it only the scopes you need.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDIT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: items, comments, planning, pages, chat, admin, destructive, or all.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDIT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: only list tools that change nothing.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDIT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: The agent API URL; change it only for another buildIt.Social deployment.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDIT_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: The image serves HTTP by default; over stdio it must be false.
